provenance.origin: REAL device traffic -- HCI captures of a CUKTECH charger, recorded 2025-07-12 with the ESP32 BLE sniffer
provenance.frame_definition: ATT Handle Value Notification value bytes: the payload after the 3-byte ATT header, 4-byte CUKTECH frame header INCLUDED, no HCI/L2CAP framing. Exactly what ble_manager dispatches on data[2].
provenance.plaintext_note: hex is the raw ciphertext as sent over the air; plaintext_hex is the real MiOT frame recovered with the session keys from that capture's own login handshake. Session keys and the device token are deliberately NOT stored here.
provenance.replay_note: Because frames are session-encrypted, replaying hex through the production decrypt path needs that session's keys. Tests should either stub ctrl.decrypt to return plaintext_hex (the pattern already used in tests/test_ble_manager.py), or feed plaintext_hex to _process_decrypted_frame.
provenance.timestamp_note: captured_at is the sniffer's per-spec conversion of its clock, which has a broken epoch and is NOT wall-clock; captured_at_estimated anchors to the capture file mtime. Trust t_rel_ms / ts_us_raw for ordering.
